messages:
Priya: Ok everyone — official email just went out: we closed $1,000,000 ARR this quarter! :tada:
DevOps Bot: Congratulations! KPI snapshot: ARR = $1,000,000, monthly_active_customers = 342, uptime_30d = 99.98% :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sam: OMG yes. mini parade in the office at 2:30pm? I will bring party hats. :tophat: :confetti_ball:
Avery: Vegan dessert option available. label for allergies please. :leafy_green:
Jordan: I'll bring a ukulele and a terrible rendition of "We Are The Champions". request for song suggestions. :guitar:
Nadia: Quick poll: cupcakes vs cake vs doughnuts? react with :one: cupcakes, :two: cake, :three: doughnuts. remote folks vote with emoji on this thread.
Rahul: sending a sad-but-hyped GIF from home. congrats y'all, so proud. :raised_hands: <https://giphy.com/gifs/party-clouds-1M-ARR|https://giphy.com/gifs/party-clouds-1M-ARR>
Product Bot: Noted in release notes: "Billing milestone: 1M ARR — thank you team!" <https://redwood.internal/release/1m-arr|link>
Priya: also thinking tiny commemorative sticker pack? design ideas welcome. maybe a tiny redwood tree crossed with a rocket. :seedling: :rocket:
Sam: i vote for a sticker that says "We scaled the thing". very on brand. :laughing:
Avery: can someone drop a quick headcount for in-office so i can finalize catering?
Jordan: in-office: me, Sam, Priya, Avery. remote: Rahul, Nadia, DevOps.
Nadia: i'll tally remote RSVP and post Zoom link 10m before.
Priya: love it. five minutes of cheer, then back to making the product even better. small milestone, big feelings. thanks team. :heart:
DevOps Bot: saved snapshot to /metrics/milestones/1938554321.json
Sam: GIFs, hats, stickers, ukulele. iconic. see you at 2:30. :v:
